conflictsOfInterest: The reviewer is the project founder and owner and the NC-9 issuer of the qualification records reviewed here. The review records that role explicitly; it is an internal owner decision, not independent external validation.
method: Guided review on 2026-11-21 from a one-page packet: the eleven requirements with the strength of their obtained evidence, the 2026-11-17 issuance on attempt t009-20261117c (32/32 probes), the Codex review triage of 2026-11-18 (T012-01 to T012-19), the residuals R1-R17, and the owner answers on T012-03 for SPEC-048 T008 (2026-11-18), T008-11 and the SPEC-049 T014 T012-03 answer (2026-11-20). humanReview.rationale: Approve SPEC-065 as an engineering specification within its documented scope: one macOS machine (27.2.1 build 26B131), Claude Code 2.1.292, the operator's own Background session, the pinned probe catalog, the subscription route, EUR 0, and the issuance valid until 2026-12-17T22:19:29Z. Accepted limits: (A) config_dir session state is not purged, a deviation from NC-7, so no independence across units or arms is claimed (T012-03); (B) verifier gaps T012-01, T012-02, T012-11, T012-14 and T012-15; (C) quota and expiry timing T012-05, T012-06 and T012-17; (D) effort is never passed, so no effort claim is made (T012-07); (E) residuals R1-R17 and the remaining low findings T012-04, T012-08 to T012-10, T012-12, T012-13, T012-16 and T012-18 stay open; T012-19 (info) needs no change. All fixes are deferred to the next SPEC-065 re-qualification, and T012-01, T012-02 and T012-03 are required in that re-qualification. Three probes (CRED-05, NET-05-CLI, HOST-01) have detector self-test controls only. This approval does not authorize execution, extend the issuance, qualify Codex, or prove general isolation; executionAuthorization stays false.
